commits.message: add English and Spanish i18n to the landing page
commits.body:
Translate the landing to English and Spanish. English stays inline as
the default so English visitors never fetch a locale file; Spanish is
lazy-loaded from docs/locale/es/es.json. The language is picked, in
order, from a lang= hash/query param, a saved choice, navigator.languages
and finally English, with an EN/ES toggle in the nav that re-renders
everything without a reload, including the JS-generated changelog,
footer date and demo labels.

Inline-markup translations go through a strict allowlist sanitizer
(code/kbd/strong/em/br/a, http(s)/# hrefs only) instead of raw innerHTML.
Commands, keys, code blocks, file paths and the mock terminal's own
screen stay in English, since they are the product, not documentation.

Fix the section nav, which was already a scrollable strip but clipped
without any visual hint, and too narrow for either language at some
widths; add scroll-edge fades and widen it so all links fit from 1180px.

commits.message: redesign the landing page with an interactive demo, themes, Open Graph and release notes
commits.body:
Redesign the landing as a night-shift radio console: a serif and mono
type pairing, phosphor accent, grain and a staggered entrance that
respects reduced motion. The hero has an interactive mock of the TUI
with a live visualizer in the six real styles, keyboard and touch
controls, and theme chips that recolor it using the real preset values
plus two custom looks. Deep links such as #theme=nord&viz=wave work.

Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags, a canonical URL, JSON-LD and a full
icon set (svg, ico, apple touch icon, manifest) with a generated social
image. Add a "What's new" section and a "Last updated" footer line fed
by docs/changelog.json through a single fetch, building the DOM with
textContent only.

Close documentation gaps: long flag names and --version, Page Up/Down
key names, when text mode is used automatically, and rename the downloads
card since episodes are saved but playback still streams.

commits.message:
ci(changelog): add git-cliff changelog and automated release workflows

Port the changelog and release automation from NeoComposer.
- changelog.yml: on push to develop, regenerate CHANGELOG.md and
  docs/changelog.json (unreleased section)
- publish-release.yml: on push to main, compute the next version with
  git-cliff, update the changelog, tag, create the GitHub release and
  fast-forward develop
- release.yml: add workflow_dispatch and stop generating release notes,
  so it only attaches binaries; publish-release.yml dispatches it after
  tagging because tags pushed with GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger workflows
- cliff.toml: conventional commit groups for this repo
- add the initial CHANGELOG.md and docs/changelog.json

commits.message:
refactor(core): remove terminal output from operations, player and mpris

Downloads now report progress through a DownloadEvent callback and
delete_episode returns a DeleteOutcome. Player::play takes a
PlayerStage callback for the connecting, buffering and ready stages.
The cli layer renders both with the same text as before.

MPRIS diagnostics move from eprintln! to a new logging module that
appends to mfp.log in the config dir, so nothing outside cli/ writes
to the terminal. This is a prerequisite for the ratatui screen.

commits.message:
refactor(playback): unify keyboard and mpris actions and make mpris optional

Add operations/playback with an Action enum and a single apply entry
point that performs the state change and the matching MPRIS updates.
Both the keyboard commands and the MPRIS callbacks in cli/play now go
through it, and the pure volume, mute and message logic is unit tested.

MprisController is now optional: if the session bus is unavailable the
error is logged and playback continues without MPRIS.

No change to the plain CLI output or the MPRIS bus name.

commits.message:
build(deps): bump crossterm to 0.28 and add ratatui

Bump crossterm from 0.27 to 0.28 and add ratatui 0.29 with default
features disabled and only the crossterm backend enabled, so both share
a single crossterm version. This prepares the TUI rewrite.

crossterm 0.28 reports key release and repeat events, so the plain CLI
input loop now only handles KeyEventKind::Press to keep one action per
key press.

commits.message:
feat(tui): add ratatui base with compact player view behind --tui

Add a tui module with a TerminalGuard that restores the terminal on
drop, quit and panic, a ~100ms event loop, and a compact player view
(episode, progress, volume, shuffle, MPRIS state and key help). It is
opt-in through `mfp play --tui`; the plain CLI is unchanged.

All key and MPRIS actions go through operations::playback::apply.
Player::play is split into a non-blocking Player::start plus the
existing blocking play, so streaming stages, downloads and the feed
fetch run on std threads and report back over mpsc without freezing
the screen. Playback start-up announcements to MPRIS are extracted to
playback::announce_episode and shared with the plain CLI.

MprisController gains is_running() so the UI can show whether MPRIS
registered on the bus.

commits.message:
feat(tui): add episode list, search and compact/full layouts

Add the full view: a scrollable episode list (favorite and now-playing
markers), the player panel and a status panel with download progress.
Enter plays the selected episode through the new Playlist::jump_to, and
"/" filters the list live without letting typed letters trigger
playback actions.

The layout is Auto, Compact or Full: Auto picks Full from 80x16, "v"
toggles it for the session and --compact starts in compact mode.

Fix download progress events, which were only emitted when the running
total was an exact multiple of 1 MiB and so almost never fired. They are
now emitted each time a new MiB boundary is crossed.

commits.message:
feat(cli): make the TUI the default and keep the text UI behind --plain

`mfp` and `mfp play` now start the full-screen TUI. `--plain` selects the
previous typed-command interface and `--compact` starts the TUI in the
compact layout; the two cannot be combined. The temporary `--tui` flag is
removed and `--version` is enabled. The UI mode is resolved by a pure,
tested function.

When stdin or stdout is not a terminal, or TERM=dumb, `mfp play` falls
back to the plain UI, and bare `mfp` prints the command overview instead
of starting playback. Without a TTY on stdin the plain UI reads commands
as lines instead of using raw mode; a closed stdin does not stop playback
and MPRIS keeps working.

Document the new behavior in the clap help, the README (keys, layouts,
plain mode, fallback, file locations) and the landing page usage section.

commits.message:
feat(audio): add audio tap and hand-written FFT spectrum analyzer

Wrap the decoded source in a TapSource that forwards every sample
unchanged and copies mono blocks into a shared ring buffer with a single
try_lock per block, so the audio thread never waits on the UI. The tap
also tracks per-channel levels and is cleared on stop and on new tracks.

Add operations/spectrum with a Hann window, a radix-2 FFT written by
hand (no new dependency), log-spaced bands, dB scaling, attack/release
smoothing and peak hold. Nothing consumes it yet; the visualizer UI
comes next.

commits.message:
feat(tui): add visualizer styles (bars, mirror, wave, dots, area, vu)

Add six audio visualizer styles as pure ratatui widgets driven by a
VisualizerData contract (bands, peaks, waveform, L/R levels and holds).
Bars, mirror, dots and area draw the spectrum with block glyphs, wave is
a braille oscilloscope and vu shows two level meters.

Every style clips to the buffer, tolerates degenerate areas and
non-finite input, and uses theme styles without hard-coded backgrounds.
VisualStyle supports cycling and name round-trips for later persistence.
Nothing is wired into the running TUI yet.

commits.message:
feat(tui): show a live audio visualizer with switchable styles

Wire the audio tap and the spectrum analyzer into the TUI through a
VizEngine that reads the tap once per frame, feeds silence when paused
or stalled so the bars decay smoothly, and keeps the VU meter and peak
hold state. The frame rate rises to 20 fps only while the visualizer is
visible and playing.

In the full view the visualizer fills the right pane and the empty
Status panel is replaced by a one-line status strip with transient
messages and download progress. The compact view shows it when the
terminal is at least 13 rows tall. "w" cycles the styles and "W" turns
it off and on; both keys go to the query while searching.

Drop the phase-A/B dead-code markers now that everything is used.

commits.message:
feat(tui): add config.toml and semantic-role themes with built-in presets

Add a tolerant config.toml loader (~/.config/mfp/config.toml) with a
[theme] active key and a reserved [visualizer] section, and a theme
system built on semantic color roles. Every color in the TUI, including
each part of the visualizer (level gradient, peak, dim, wave and the VU
zones and hold), now resolves through the active Theme.

Ship six presets: default (identical to the previous look), solarized,
high-contrast, gruvbox, nord and dracula. Users can add themes in
~/.config/mfp/themes/<name>.toml that inherit from a preset and override
roles with names, hex values or ANSI indexes. Level gradients interpolate
when their stops are RGB and step otherwise. A non-Reset background is
painted over the whole frame.

Unknown or invalid themes, path-like theme names and malformed config
files fall back to the default look and log the reason to mfp.log.
Add the toml crate (parse feature only) for the config and theme files.

commits.message:
feat(tui): rebind h/v/V keys and read visualizer settings from config.toml

Rebind the TUI keys: h hides or shows the episode list (replacing the
old v layout toggle), v cycles the visualizer style (was w) and V turns
the visualizer on or off (was W). w and W are now unbound. While
searching, all of them go to the query. The theme has no key: it is
chosen only in config.toml.

Read [visualizer] style and enabled from config.toml once at startup;
an unknown style falls back to bars and logs the reason. Changes made
with v and V last for the session, and the app never writes the file.

Update the --compact help, the README (keys, layouts, a short
configuration section) and the landing page key rows to match, and drop
the leftover dead-code markers.

commits.message: add config.toml and semantic-role themes with built-in presets
commits.body:
Add a tolerant config.toml loader (~/.config/mfp/config.toml) with a
[theme] active key and a reserved [visualizer] section, and a theme
system built on semantic color roles. Every color in the TUI, including
each part of the visualizer (level gradient, peak, dim, wave and the VU
zones and hold), now resolves through the active Theme.

Ship six presets: default (identical to the previous look), solarized,
high-contrast, gruvbox, nord and dracula. Users can add themes in
~/.config/mfp/themes/<name>.toml that inherit from a preset and override
roles with names, hex values or ANSI indexes. Level gradients interpolate
when their stops are RGB and step otherwise. A non-Reset background is
painted over the whole frame.

Unknown or invalid themes, path-like theme names and malformed config
files fall back to the default look and log the reason to mfp.log.
Add the toml crate (parse feature only) for the config and theme files.

commits.message: show a live audio visualizer with switchable styles
commits.body:
Wire the audio tap and the spectrum analyzer into the TUI through a
VizEngine that reads the tap once per frame, feeds silence when paused
or stalled so the bars decay smoothly, and keeps the VU meter and peak
hold state. The frame rate rises to 20 fps only while the visualizer is
visible and playing.

In the full view the visualizer fills the right pane and the empty
Status panel is replaced by a one-line status strip with transient
messages and download progress. The compact view shows it when the
terminal is at least 13 rows tall. "w" cycles the styles and "W" turns
it off and on; both keys go to the query while searching.

Drop the phase-A/B dead-code markers now that everything is used.

commits.message: add audio tap and hand-written FFT spectrum analyzer
commits.body:
Wrap the decoded source in a TapSource that forwards every sample
unchanged and copies mono blocks into a shared ring buffer with a single
try_lock per block, so the audio thread never waits on the UI. The tap
also tracks per-channel levels and is cleared on stop and on new tracks.

Add operations/spectrum with a Hann window, a radix-2 FFT written by
hand (no new dependency), log-spaced bands, dB scaling, attack/release
smoothing and peak hold. Nothing consumes it yet; the visualizer UI
comes next.

commits.message: make the TUI the default and keep the text UI behind --plain
commits.body:
`mfp` and `mfp play` now start the full-screen TUI. `--plain` selects the
previous typed-command interface and `--compact` starts the TUI in the
compact layout; the two cannot be combined. The temporary `--tui` flag is
removed and `--version` is enabled. The UI mode is resolved by a pure,
tested function.

When stdin or stdout is not a terminal, or TERM=dumb, `mfp play` falls
back to the plain UI, and bare `mfp` prints the command overview instead
of starting playback. Without a TTY on stdin the plain UI reads commands
as lines instead of using raw mode; a closed stdin does not stop playback
and MPRIS keeps working.

Document the new behavior in the clap help, the README (keys, layouts,
plain mode, fallback, file locations) and the landing page usage section.

commits.message: add episode list, search and compact/full layouts
commits.body:
Add the full view: a scrollable episode list (favorite and now-playing
markers), the player panel and a status panel with download progress.
Enter plays the selected episode through the new Playlist::jump_to, and
"/" filters the list live without letting typed letters trigger
playback actions.

The layout is Auto, Compact or Full: Auto picks Full from 80x16, "v"
toggles it for the session and --compact starts in compact mode.

Fix download progress events, which were only emitted when the running
total was an exact multiple of 1 MiB and so almost never fired. They are
now emitted each time a new MiB boundary is crossed.

commits.message: add ratatui base with compact player view behind --tui
commits.body:
Add a tui module with a TerminalGuard that restores the terminal on
drop, quit and panic, a ~100ms event loop, and a compact player view
(episode, progress, volume, shuffle, MPRIS state and key help). It is
opt-in through `mfp play --tui`; the plain CLI is unchanged.

All key and MPRIS actions go through operations::playback::apply.
Player::play is split into a non-blocking Player::start plus the
existing blocking play, so streaming stages, downloads and the feed
fetch run on std threads and report back over mpsc without freezing
the screen. Playback start-up announcements to MPRIS are extracted to
playback::announce_episode and shared with the plain CLI.

MprisController gains is_running() so the UI can show whether MPRIS
registered on the bus.

commits.message: bump crossterm to 0.28 and add ratatui
commits.body:

input loop now only handles KeyEventKind::Press to keep one action per
key press.

commits.message: unify keyboard and mpris actions and make mpris optional
commits.body:
Add operations/playback with an Action enum and a single apply entry
point that performs the state change and the matching MPRIS updates.
Both the keyboard commands and the MPRIS callbacks in cli/play now go
through it, and the pure volume, mute and message logic is unit tested.

MprisController is now optional: if the session bus is unavailable the
error is logged and playback continues without MPRIS.

No change to the plain CLI output or the MPRIS bus name.

commits.message: add git-cliff changelog and automated release workflows
commits.body:
Port the changelog and release automation from NeoComposer.
- changelog.yml: on push to develop, regenerate CHANGELOG.md and
  docs/changelog.json (unreleased section)
- publish-release.yml: on push to main, compute the next version with
  git-cliff, update the changelog, tag, create the GitHub release and
  fast-forward develop
- release.yml: add workflow_dispatch and stop generating release notes,
  so it only attaches binaries; publish-release.yml dispatches it after
  tagging because tags pushed with GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger workflows
- cliff.toml: conventional commit groups for this repo
- add the initial CHANGELOG.md and docs/changelog.json
